title: Shinonome Ena — Hermit Searcher〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mhm... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mhm... I'm still not done, but maybe I should rest a little...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh, who is it?
Don't they know what time it is...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want to make up for what I did the other day. Are you free this weekend?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The other day...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I guess I'm not as well as I thought I was! I'm fine otherwise, honest...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I'm gonna head home!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does this mean Mizuki feels a little better now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, maybe what I said is starting to take effect.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't tell you right now, but when I feel ready... I hope you'll be willing to hear me out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would that work...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe Mizuki is actually starting to feel better. Thank goodness.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's send a reply!
The weekend
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got here a little early out of sheer excitement.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But Mizuki probably won't be here for... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're here already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was the one who invited you. Also, I couldn't wait for today♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that you're excited, but don't forget that you owe me a nice day out, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know♪
Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We got so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right♪ That concealer we just bought seemed really good too! I can't wait to try it out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It might even be able to cover up those bags under your eyes, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They're hidden well enough already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. But you're not denying that they're there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm...?!
Ena, it's that shop!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the one we went to that other time, and you couldn't decide which clothes to get...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! They still have a white one and a pink one left too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This has to be fate!
I have to get them!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you mean both?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really want to...
But we already bought so many cosmetics...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess I'm fated to not make up my mind instead of actually buying them, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. You can take as much time as you want.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm okay with it as long as Mizuki's having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Ena, which do you think is better?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're asking me now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna hear what you think!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd say white.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You usually wear a lot of pink, and it might be nice to have something like this in your wardrobe, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
Ena's giving a reasoned explanation?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! What's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I'm just joking♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Being a good wardrobe addition aside, do you think it looks good on me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Honestly, that's gonna decide everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, in that case...
Pink.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! Pink it is!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, just like that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm gonna go take this up front!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
After spending so much time on this the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm back!
It's all squared away.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There you are...
What's with this frilly lace getup?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It caught my eye while I was in line for check out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wanna try it on, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet it'll look great on you! I'm not forcing you to buy it or anything, so just try it out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How's the store gonna feel about this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that♪
The customer's always right!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's what you're going with...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seeing you wear this might inspire me to make the video for the song we're working on even better! Enough to make Kanade really like it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see right through your bluff, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But, I'll bite.
Just to try on, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While you're at it, wanna try these on too? Or these? They seem pretty classy!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, what are you doing?!
Don't pile on just because you think you can!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! You're just trying them on, right? What's the harm in a few more?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, look at this one piece! It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, fine. After I'm done trying this one.
